# 🪪 AGR-055 · `expense-audit-swarm`

> Workers audit expense lines against policy in parallel.

| Card ID | Domain | Pattern | Nodes | Edges | Verifiers | Routers | Max steps | Risk surface |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AGR-055` | finance | **parallel-swarm** | 3 | 3 | 1 | 0 | 30 | execute |

## The graph

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    N0["plan<br/><i>planner</i>"]
    N1["work<br/><i>worker</i>"]
    N2{{"verify<br/><i>verifier</i>"}}
    N0 --> N1

```

Legend: `[/…/]` router · `{{…}}` verifier · `[…]` worker/agent node.

## What it does

Workers audit expense lines against policy in parallel.

## Why it should deliver results

Independent workers cover disjoint slices of the input at the same time. Because they cannot see each other's drafts, agreement is evidence and disagreement surfaces blind spots; the aggregator merges with explicit rules. Wall-clock time is roughly the slowest worker, not the sum.

- **Exit contract** — violations carry line id and policy rule
- **Machine-checked** — `violations carry line id and policy rule`
- **Bounded** — hard stop after 30 steps; every loop edge is condition-guarded
- **Gate-checked** — schema + lint + structural gate run in CI; golden eval cases are the next step for this card (see `evals/` for the format)

## Node roster

| Node | Speciality | Kind | Abilities |

| `plan` | planner | agent | decompose_goal |

| `verify` | verifier | verifier | run_command |

## Edge logic

| From | To | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| `plan` | `work` | always |
| `work` | `verify` | always |
| `verify` | `work` | verify_failed and attempts < 3 |

## Optional use-cases

Adjacent entries from the use-case catalog this card adapts to with small edits:

- **budget-variance-analysis** (finance, map-reduce) — Explain variance per cost center, reduce to an exec brief. *Verify:* variances sum to total; drivers cite ledger lines.
- **fraud-pattern-triage** (finance, router) — Route flagged transactions to rule, anomaly, or manual review. *Verify:* routing precision measured against labeled history.
- **regulatory-filing-check** (finance, parallel-swarm) — Workers check filing sections against requirement checklists. *Verify:* every checklist item pass or fail with location.
- **portfolio-report-generation** (finance, pipeline) — Assemble informational holdings and performance reporting. *Verify:* figures reconcile to custodian data; no advice emitted.
- **brand-consistency-audit** (content-marketing, parallel-swarm) — Workers audit assets against voice and visual guidelines. *Verify:* violations reported per asset with rule ids.
